span.p:
App + DB on same machine
Scale: t3.medium → c5.xlarge <- 2x RAM, 4x CPU
Limits: CPU contention at peak

span.p:
Integration rules:
1. Use connection pooling (PgBouncer or app-level)
2. Set statement_timeout = 30s (prevent runaway queries)
3. Separate read and write connections in code
4. Use EXPLAIN ANALYZE to find queries that exceed
the vertical scaling budget
